newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures rebound as buyers emerge.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures rebound as buyers emerge.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures rebounded in late on Tuesday on a technical correction as buyers emerged following heavy losses in early trade, brokers said.

January had traded as low as $22.73, which was off 14 cents from the previous close on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE). It later rebounded strongly to last trade at a day's high of $22.96, up nine cents from the last IPE close of $22.87 per barrel, after recording 251 lots at 0953 GMT.
A broker said the market will hover around the current support of $22.90, with resistance seen at $23.50-$$23.85
February last traded at $22.55, up nine cents from its last IPE close, after trading 60 lots at 0949 GMT. February had traded at a low of $22.43 earlier.

The after-hours ACCESS system also rebounded in late trading with December last traded at $23.90, up two cents from its last NYMEX close, while January last traded at $23.71, five cents over its previous close.
